overview_description.description:
Koshex provides a personal finance and wealth management service. It is automating wealth creation for 400 million Indian millennials with data-driven insights around their day-to-day finances to save more and invest well.

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
